summary: High Tide Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K with interim financial statements for the three and nine months ended July 31, 2026, in the form of a Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q equivalent. The filing includes condensed interim consolidated financials, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications, incorporated by reference into its Form F-10 shelf registration. Reported revenue was C$198.8 million for the quarter, with total assets of C$369.3 million and shareholders' equity of C$119.9 million. No transactional terms, stakeholder changes, board recommendations, or special-situation mechanics were disclosed. Watch for subsequent events and any future capital-markets activity.
